name: propositions
description: Author-claim infrastructure for academic LaTeX manuscripts: line-addressable propositions (JSONL), R1-R13 mechanical validator, audit chain (symbols / citations / code-manuscript / prop-iso), extraction discipline, and the domain-general manuscript-QA skills (clarity-audit, proofread with dual derivation/empirical modes, manuscript-audit). an extraction skill (paragraph → propositions behind a validator and a no-omission coverage gate), and ledger profiles (default / empirical). Supports propositions-ledger schema versions up to 1.7 (v1.2+/v1.4+/v1.6/v1.7 rules applied conditionally, incl. multi-file \input manuscripts), plus verification records: a verification.jsonl sidecar with its validator and proofread-checklist conversion, and article structure: structure.json / discourse.jsonl sidecars (commitments, section roles, adjacent relations) with an S1-S6 validator, a state query and the construct skill (annotate, or say what the next sentence of a draft should do). Originally developed as the 'Locke project'.
